Name: Female Bachelors dialogue overhaul
Author: valoodx
Description:
[size=6][b][color=#ff0000]Versions[/color]
[/b][size=3]0.2:  Changes a Sabrina event of Complement of decor in "his" room.  to her instead, Huge thanks to KI4T for finding this one.[/size][b]
[/b][size=3]0.3: Fixes dialogue with Alex heart event 10 scene, now she refers to you as him instead of another guy,  also fixes event of Group 10 Heart scene, to refer as girls instead of guys when confronted by the group, Huge thanks to 4thDimensional4d for finding this one.[/size][/size]
[size=6][b][color=#ff0000]Warning! Read before download!!![/color][/b][/size][size=6]
[/size]The main mod is not compatible with any mod that overwrites the vanilla dialogue files.
If you do not want to overwrite the files, then just download the content patch file only,
you must still have obviously [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=files]content patcher[/url] with all the required files for it!
While not required to change the portrait I highly recommend that you download the portraits mods,
otherwise it will be weird if you address therm as girls while still looking as boys! links are down [color=#ff0000]below[/color]!!!

[color=#ff0000][size=5][b]Adarian Portrait Mods[/b]
[/size][/color]You can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/474/?]Adarian [/url]original portrait mod to change the girls portrait mod or rather use the content patch by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2165]ZidanReign
[/url]

[size=5][color=#ff0000][b]Shane Portrait Mod[/b][/color]
[/size]You can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1946?tab=posts]Rekooooon[/url] original Shane girl mod,
But I'll rather recommend the [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-RRV57azx05yJ51Dk1EB3FbjNjdGXuuG]content patcher[/url] by Croofe since that one does not comes with a corrupt cursor file that
makes the lights in the window blurry!!! you were warned!
[b][size=5]
[/size][color=#ff0000][size=4]INSTALLATION[/size][/color][/b]
[size=2]1.)Download this mod[b]
[/b]2.)Locate your Stardew Valley folder in your "steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content
3.)Let files overwrite original files
4.)Enjoy!
[color=#ff0000]Warning!: DO NOT PUT ON SMAPI SINCE THIS IS A OVERWRITE MOD!, I'm still trying to figure out how to make a content file, unless of course if you want to help, which if you do, please message me so I can link to your post and give credit.[/color]
[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]
CREDITS[/b][/size][/color]
[/size](Huge Kudos for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/22709859]Invartorzen[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9019485]KeionDryke[/url] for inspiring me, And Specially [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34618175]AdarinSinner[/url] for making the gender swap bachelor mod, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51528986]Rekooooon[/url] for making the Shane girl Mod , please check their profiles!)

(Content patcher is finally release all thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/27024274]Pepoluan[/url], would never had happened since I never understood how to make a content patcher, please show your support by going to his profile page and give him kudos.)
